first_network_at_utc: Client observation of first complete response line via urllib.readline; not a packet-level capture or exact network packet arrival timestamp
first_model_content_at_utc: First parsed SSE delta with nonempty visible or reasoning content
client_end_at_utc: Complete response read with finish_reason and DONE or EOF; not GPU kernel end
time_domain: Workload UTC and monotonic from N305, same host as TTO
usage: Individual server-reported usage retained; no character-to-token estimate
